enchantments.tooltip: Void Intensity +12%: +12% Enhancement bonus to critical damage with Negative and Poison spells.
Void Lore +12: Passive: Your Negative Energy and Poison spells gain a 12% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Poison Guard: This item carries a potent venom that may be contracted by enemies that hit you, dealing 1d6 Strength damage. A successful Fortitude Save (DC 20) will negate this effect.

Nearly Complete: Spell Focus: This item isn't quite finished, but it's only a step away from completion. Bring it to the forges on the upper floor of Gravenhollow and combine it with melted materials to restore this item to its full potential.
